stories.title: Top secrets come spilling out
stories.summary: A CNN opinion article recalls how British analysts deciphered the 1917 Zimmermann Telegram, in which Germany proposed unrestricted submarine warfare and sought Mexico's support against the United States. Publication of the message caused a sensation and helped propel the US into the First World War against Germany.

links.headline: Top secrets come spilling out

When it became public, the Zimmerman Telegram caused a sensation, helping propel the US into the conflict against Germany.

stories.title: ‘My social life completely plummeted’: gen Z is fighting back against big tech
stories.summary: Some members of Generation Z are using distraction-blocking apps and stripped-down phones to reduce their dependence on major technology platforms. The Guardian reports that young people are trying to reclaim social lives and attention they believe those platforms exploit for profit.

stories.title: AI-driven disinformation running rampant on social media before US midterms, experts warn
stories.summary: Experts warn that social media is carrying an unprecedented volume of AI-generated disinformation ahead of the November US midterm elections. They say misleading posts are probably evading detection as companies including Meta scale back efforts to protect voters from election falsehoods.
